road_class.description: Road class rank is a reporting-bias-only baseline.

random.description: Seeded random scores establish the chance baseline.

near_water.description: Proximity to any OSM water feature baseline.

builtup.description: Built-up fraction baseline for dense-settlement reporting bias.

logreg_design.description: Regularized logistic regression on the design section 4.2 inputs.

lgbm_design.description: Small strongly regularized LightGBM on design section 4.2 inputs.

lgbm_all.description: Regularized LightGBM using all raw route features.

lgbm_all_cityrank.description: Regularized LightGBM using city-rank features and road class.

lgbm_phys_cityrank.description: LightGBM on city-rank terrain, water and non-built-up land cover only.

exposure_only.description: Reporting exposure alone explains route labels, without physical flood signals.

pu_bagging.description: Bagging positive-unlabeled LightGBM models can reduce noisy negative labels.

exposure_matched.description: Matching unlabeled negatives on exposure should reveal signal beyond reporting opportunity.

exposure_nuisance.description: Replacing exposure predictors by training medians at prediction time removes learned reporting bias.

monotone_phys.description: Monotone physical constraints should keep susceptibility directions coherent across cities.

compact_fab.description: A compact FABDEM physical feature set should reduce noise from duplicate raster predictors.

logreg_phys_cityrank.description: Regularized linear susceptibility on physical city-rank features should transfer with less variance.

spline_phys.description: Spline-binned physical city-rank inputs may capture nonlinear flood thresholds without a large tree ensemble.

rank_ensemble.description: A rank average of linear and tree physical scorers can balance robustness and nonlinear signal.

shallow_phys.description: A shallower regularized physical LightGBM should avoid fitting city-specific reporting structure.

extratrees_phys.description: ExtraTrees on physical city-rank features may model threshold interactions with lower variance than boosting.

histgb_phys.description: Histogram gradient boosting on physical city-rank features may learn smooth transfer thresholds.

terrain_water_only.description: Removing all land-cover inputs tests whether hydrologic terrain alone transfers beyond urban exposure.
